title: About Me
content: I enjoy learning new technologies and building projects that solve real-world problems.

My interests include Full Stack Web Development, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI. I enjoy building modern web applications, exploring data, and creating AI-powered solutions that make software more useful and intelligent.
Beyond coding, I like understanding how technologies work behind the scenes and focus on learning concepts rather than simply following tutorials.
I believe learning is a lifelong journey, so I continuously improve my skills by building projects, exploring new ideas, and challenging myself with new technologies.
learningPhilosophy: I believe the best way to learn is by building real projects.
I enjoy understanding how things work instead of only learning how to use them.
Every project helps me improve my knowledge and become a better developer.
openSource: I enjoy exploring open-source projects to learn how real software is built and to improve my development skills.
collaboration: I enjoy learning from other developers, sharing ideas, and working together to build better software.
goal: My goal is to build useful products by combining web development, data, and artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems.
